items.summary: Precision measurement company Mettler-Toledo (NYSE:MTD) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue up 6.3% year on year to $1.09 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $12.57 per share was 3.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
